verdict: This outfit possesses less aesthetic energy than absolute zero and looks like it was dredged out of a thrift store clearance bin in 1994.
detailedQuote: Pairing a muddy taupe blazer with a barcode-patterned dress shirt is a physics anomaly of pure sartorial depression. He looks ready to fail an entire lecture hall on thermodynamics purely out of spite for modern tailoring.
